statement: (∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (s : ℂ), 1 / 2 < s.re → (χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1) → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s ≠ 0) → ∀ (x : ℝ) (d a : ℕ), 100 ≤ x → 3 ≤ d → Nat.Coprime a d → |(∑ n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter (fun n => Nat.ModEq d n a), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) - x / (Nat.totient d : ℝ)| ≤ Real.sqrt x * ((Real.log x) ^ 2 / (8 * Real.pi) + Real.log (d : ℝ) * Real.log x / (2 * Real.pi) + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.log x + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (d : ℝ))

plain_statement.en: Grenié–Molteni (2019, Corollary 1) explicit GRH bound for ψ(x; d, a): for x ≥ 100, d ≥ 3, and (a, d) = 1, |ψ(x; d, a) - x/φ(d)| ≤ √x (log² x / (8π) + log d log x / (2π) + 3/4 log x + 1/2 log d).
plain_statement.zh: Grenié–Molteni（2019，推论 1）算术级数显式 GRH 界：对 x ≥ 100、d ≥ 3 且 gcd(a, d) = 1，成立 |ψ(x; d, a) − x/φ(d)| ≤ √x (log² x / (8π) + log d log x / (2π) + 3/4 log x + 1/2 log d)。

brief.en: Combine orthogonality of characters mod d, L-goldbach-gm-primitive-euler-loss (induction to primitive χ*), L-goldbach-gm-smoothed-explicit-formula (optimizing δ to absorb unsmoothing error over x ∈ [e^(-δ)X, e^(δ)X]), and Schoenfeld / RH at q = 1 for the principal character. Verified community imports (≤ 16 transitive) are permitted.
brief.zh: 按模 d 特征正交展开 ψ(x; d, a)，用 L-goldbach-gm-primitive-euler-loss 化归到本原特征 χ*，结合 L-goldbach-gm-smoothed-explicit-formula 与优化参数 δ 消去光滑化误差（主特征由 q = 1 给出）。可导入已验证社区模块（≤ 16 个）。
